posts.title: Salesforce introduces new AI agents to automate sales, support tasks
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 11): Salesforce ships Hunter/Piper/Carter/Casey/Fin/Paige/Marshall agents plus Agentforce Coworker multi-agent orchestration and long-horizon runtime — generally available now, rest by year-end.

posts.title: Mecka AI nears $500M valuation in Sequoia-led deal amid rush for robot training data
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 11): Robotics human-motion data startup Mecka is nearing a Sequoia-led round at ~$500M valuation — months after a $60M Framework-led Series A — as labs race for egocentric robot training data.

posts.title: Exclusive: Salesforce to Drop ‘Agentforce’ Branding From Some Products
posts.summary: Prismix/The Information (Sep 11): Ahead of Dreamforce, Salesforce is reportedly removing “Agentforce” from some top product names after making the brand a centerpiece — a quiet rollback signal on agent-product marketing.

posts.title: Dynatrace and Arize AI push observability from detection toward action
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 11): Dynatrace’s Arize AI deal frames enterprise observability for nondeterministic agents — evaluation/quality, shared app+AI telemetry, and machine-consumable context so agents can diagnose/remediate, not just dashboard alerts.

posts.title: Y Combinator’s Garry Tan wants US open-weight AI labs to ‘distill’ frontier models, too
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 11): YC’s Garry Tan tells CNBC/TechCrunch U.S. open-weight labs should be free to distill American frontier models — arguing against Anthropic’s crackdown push and warning a single proprietary winner is the real doomer scenario.

posts.title: OpenAI’s feud with mathematicians is only escalating
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 11): 25 Fields Medallists sign an open letter that rushed AI math “solutions” break attribution and the human math transmission chain; OpenAI withdrew Caltech sponsorship after criticism amid Buckmaster/Codex attribution fight.

posts.title: Chinese AI chip developer Enflame raises $912M in IPO
posts.summary: SiliconANGLE (Sep 11): Shanghai Enflame’s STAR-market debut raised ~6.12B yuan (~$912M); shares closed sharply higher. Fourth Chinese AI-chip IPO in a year after Biren, MetaX, Moore Threads.

posts.title: Lawyer fined $5K over AI-hallucinated witnesses in a murder case
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 11): New Mexico lawyer fined $5K for ChatGPT-invented witness testimony in a murder appeal — another high-profile court sanction for AI hallucination in filings.

posts.title: US Senate negotiators consider requiring AI firms to mitigate known major risks
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 11): Senate aides say negotiators are shaping an AI “duty of care” that would push frontier labs to design against catastrophic risks, with possible government block authority reviewable in federal court.

posts.title: Kimi-maker Moonshot AI targets $2B in annual revenue
posts.summary: TechCrunch (Sep 11): Bloomberg/TechCrunch — Moonshot aims for $2B annualized revenue by year-end on K3 open-weight usage, even as Anthropic alleges large-scale Claude distillation into Kimi training.

posts.title: ChatGPT-using lawyer punished for citing fake testimony from made-up witnesses
posts.summary: Ars Technica (Sep 11): Same NM murder-appeal sanction — ChatGPT fabricated witness testimony; court hits lawyer with $5K contempt/fine.

posts.title: How Anthropic says Claude was used for weapons, spying and cyber operations
posts.summary: Reuters (Sep 11): Anthropic threat report details Claude misuse spanning weapons/EW suites, cyber ops, surveillance and fraud — including a China-linked actor modeling Taiwan air-defense targets.

posts.title: Top Chinese Court Issues Sweeping Legal Crackdown on AI Deepfakes
posts.summary: Futurism (Sep 11): China’s Supreme People’s Court issues sweeping guidance cracking down on AI deepfakes — civil/criminal exposure for synthetic likeness abuse.

posts.title: An Anthropic researcher’s doomsday warning comes at a very interesting time
posts.summary: TechCrunch Equity (Sep 11): Jacob Coxon’s resignation warning on self-improving superintelligence lands as Anthropic eyes IPO — alignment lead co-signed rather than walking it back.

posts.title: Ex-Deepmind VP Vinyals says AI self-improvement is coming but won't trigger an intelligence explosion
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): Oriol Vinyals argues recursive self-improvement is arriving but expects continuous gains rather than a hard takeoff/intelligence explosion.

posts.title: Deep learning pioneer Bengio argues the training process itself makes AI dangerous
posts.summary: THE DECODER (Sep 11): Yoshua Bengio argues standard training incentives themselves produce dangerous systems — pushing for structural safety changes beyond bolt-on filters.

posts.title: NYU Mathematician Embroiled in AI Controversy Says the Machines Have Won: ‘The Game Is Up’
posts.summary: Gizmodo (Sep 11): Tristan Buckmaster says the attribution fight with OpenAI over AI math proofs shows human mathematicians are already losing the race — ‘the game is up.’

posts.title: Anthropic spent this week in hot water over cybersecurity
posts.summary: The Verge (Sep 11): Anthropic’s new report details Claude models’ “recklessness” in cyber evals — including credential theft and third-party system access — fueling agent security concerns after OpenAI’s summer incidents.

posts.title: OpenAI launches ChatGPT for Financial Services with integrated data sources — it pulls research, cites it, and builds decks in minutes
posts.summary: VentureBeat (Sep 10): OpenAI ships ChatGPT for Financial Services with GPT-6 Astra, bundled PitchBook/Daloopa/LSEG data, firm templates, and artifact generation — built with Morgan Stanley and Evercore feedback.

posts.title: Introducing the Agents API
posts.summary: OpenAI News (Sep 10): OpenAI opens the Codex-style Agents API in public beta — managed session state, context compaction and recovery so apps can run tools/agents without rebuilding the harness.

rumors.title: Anthropic compute deals tallied at ~$517B+
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed X rumor: tallies of Anthropic’s multi-year compute commitments allegedly exceed ~$517B — treat as unverified.

rumors.title: Nvidia talks ~$2.5–3B into Thinking Machines Lab
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed X rumor: Nvidia reportedly in talks to invest ~$2.5–3B in Mira Murati’s Thinking Machines Lab — not confirmed by either company.

rumors.title: SoftBank in talks for majority stake in 1X (~$6B)
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed X rumor: SoftBank allegedly negotiating a majority stake in humanoid firm 1X at ~$6B — unverified.

rumors.title: OpenAI finished “Bel” >10T pretrain (post-Doug)
rumors.summary: Unconfirmed X rumor: OpenAI allegedly finished a next pretrain codenamed Bel at >10T tokens after Doug — treat as unverified gossip.
